title: Differentiable MPM — a ground-up textbook
intro: The teaching companion to the DiffMPM work, written to be read in order. Motivation frames why differentiable physics matters, with no equations. Prerequisites build the math and the simulation mental model from zero; skim them once you have them. Core is the spine: the forward engine, how gradients flow through a rollout and how to verify one, what breaks, how materials enter the solver, what happens when you try to learn them, and finally how any of it gets drawn. Task runs link into these pages rather than restating them.
